cheatsheet.ex: We haven't found product-market fit yet.
We shipped the MVP in six weeks.
We pivoted from B2C to B2B.
Our monthly churn is five percent.
Day-30 retention is our key metric.
We ship a new feature every week.
We have twelve months of runway.
We need to hire before we scale.

cards.q: «We have twelve months of runway» значит…
cards.explain: runway = сколько компания проживёт на текущие деньги.

cards.q: Как сказать «мы сменили стратегию на B2B»?

audio.text: We shipped the MVP in six weeks, and retention doubled after the second update.

options: MVP за 6 недель, удержание выросло вдвое после 2-го обновления

audio.text: Our churn is too high, so we're focusing on onboarding before we scale.

cards.prompt: Мы ещё не нашли product-market fit.
Мы выпускаем новую функцию каждую неделю.

cards.text: We pivoted from B2C to B2B, and our churn dropped by half.
cards.tr: Мы переключились с B2C на B2B, и отток упал вдвое.

cards.text: We have eighteen months of runway, so we can focus on retention before we scale.
cards.tr: Денег у нас на восемнадцать месяцев, так что можем сфокусироваться на удержании, прежде чем масштабироваться.

n1.say: You have two minutes. What problem are you solving?
n1.tr: У вас две минуты. Какую проблему вы решаете?

choices.text: Adults with ADHD quit language apps fast. We built short, low-pressure lessons that keep them coming back.
We have a very cool app with many features.
choices.feedback: Инвестору нужна проблема, а не список фич.

choices.text: Yes. Day-30 retention is forty percent, which is double the market average.
We shipped the MVP last month, and early users love it.
choices.feedback: Хорошо, но нужны цифры: retention, users.

n3.say: What's your biggest risk right now?
n3.tr: Какой у вас главный риск сейчас?

choices.text: Churn after the first week. We're fixing it with daily reminders and streaks.
Honestly, we haven't found product-market fit in the B2B market yet.

n4.say: How much runway do you have?
n4.tr: На сколько у вас хватит денег?

choices.text: Six months. With this round, we'd have eighteen months to scale.
We're running at almost zero cost, so our runway is long.

n5.say: Okay, send me your deck. Let's set up a follow-up call.
n5.tr: Хорошо, пришлите презентацию. Договоримся о следующем созвоне.
